title: Report the revert rate of merged PRs in the ledger
body:
Source: t-tpkc9xz trial (h), .krn/runs/research/rss-trials/f-g-h-radar.md
Outcome: krn ledger --reverts prints reverts/merged over the last N merged PRs, so a revert rate sits beside first-push-green.
Proof: node --test test/outcome ledger test with a fixture of PRs titled Revert "..." asserting the printed reverts/merged ratio.
